title: Dimensions of the carrier materials

cell_spans.description: Printed 'Carrier specifications' spans the Material and Dimension columns

markdown:
| Name | Material | Dimension, mm |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Captor® | Polyurethane | 30 x 25 x 25 |
| Linpor® | Polyurethane | 10 to 13 cubes |
notes: Printed below the table: 'Source:  Metcalf & Eddy, 2003' (two spaces after the colon).
Transcriber layout note: two printed header levels. Level 1 reads 'Name' and 'Carrier specifications'; level 2 reads 'Material' and 'Dimension, mm'.
The dimension is printed '30 x 25 x 25' with a lower-case letter x, not a multiplication sign; retained. Table 5.59 on page 506 prints '3×3×3 mm' with a multiplication sign.
The registered trade mark sign is printed after Captor and Linpor; retained.
Printed as '10 to 13 cubes' (words, no dimension signs); retained.

transcription.method: Direct viewing of the annotation-cleaned 144 dpi page renders and 260-800 dpi crops of the same pages; no OCR, no paid service
transcription.observations: Caption, both header levels and both data rows read from a 400 dpi crop of the table band.
